source: Multiple guides (Zelda Central, Game-Secret, IGN, GameRant) 2026-11-24
game: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (Switch 2 Remake)

quests.name: Link Wakes Up
quests.description: Beginning of Link's adventure in Kokiri Forest

quests.name: The Great Deku Tree
quests.description: Explore the Great Deku Tree dungeon

quests.name: Princess of Hyrule Castle
quests.description: Meet Princess Zelda at Hyrule Castle

quests.name: Three Spiritual Stones

sub_quests.name: Spiritual Stone of Fire
sub_quests.description: Complete Dodongo's Cavern and obtain Goron's Ruby

sub_quests.name: Spiritual Stone of Water
sub_quests.description: Complete Jabu-Jabu's Belly and obtain Zora's Sapphire

quests.notes: Kokiri's Emerald obtained from Great Deku Tree (quest 2)

quests.name: Awakening the Five Sages
quests.description: Complete the five Sage Temples as Adult Link

sub_quests.name: Forest Temple Mysteries
sub_quests.description: Complete the Forest Temple and awaken Saria as the Forest Sage

sub_quests.name: Disaster in Goron City
sub_quests.description: Complete the Fire Temple and awaken Darunia as the Fire Sage

sub_quests.name: Disaster in Zora Domain
sub_quests.description: Complete the Water Temple and awaken Ruto as the Water Sage

sub_quests.name: Creature of Darkness
sub_quests.description: Complete the Shadow Temple and awaken Impa as the Shadow Sage

sub_quests.name: Missing in the Desert
sub_quests.description: Complete the Spirit Temple and awaken Nabooru as the Spirit Sage

quests.notes: Temple order is flexible; Forest Temple typically done first

quests.name: Broken Windmill, Dry Well
quests.description: Learn Song of Storms from Music Man in Windmill, explore Bottom of the Well
quests.notes: Required for Shadow Temple access (Lens of Truth from Bottom of the Well)

quests.name: Light and Darkness
quests.description: Final story chapter - Ganon's Castle and final battles

quests.name: Malon's Friend
quests.description: Befriend Malon at Lon Lon Ranch, learn Epona's Song
quests.notes: Required to obtain Epona as Adult Link; technically optional but highly recommended

quests.name: A Song of the Royal Family
quests.description: Learn Zelda's Lullaby and Sun's Song
quests.notes: Zelda's Lullaby from Princess Zelda; Sun's Song from Royal Family's Tomb in Graveyard

quests.name: Happy Mask Shopkeeper
quests.description: Complete the Happy Mask Trading Quest
steps: Obtain Keaton Mask → sell to Kakariko Village Guard
Obtain Skull Mask → sell to Skull Kid in Lost Woods
Obtain Spooky Mask → sell to graveyard child in Hyrule Field
Obtain Bunny Hood → sell to Running Man in Hyrule Field
quests.notes: Must sell each mask for specified price before next mask unlocks. Final reward: access to Mask of Truth + 3 other masks (Goron, Zora, Gerudo)

quests.name: To the Great Fairy
quests.description: Find and visit Great Fairy Fountains
quests.notes: 6 Great Fairy Fountains total; some give essential upgrades (Magic Meter, Double Magic, Double Defense)

quests.name: Stir the Scarecrow's Soul
quests.description: Teach Bonooru the Scarecrow a custom song as Child, summon Pierre as Adult
quests.notes: Required for some Gold Skulltulas and Heart Pieces

quests.name: From a Pocket Egg Comes...
quests.notes: 11-step trading sequence; some steps are timed (Odd Mushroom, Eyeball Frog)

side_quests.notes: Side quests appear in Threads of Time menu alongside main story quests. 'Broken Windmill, Dry Well' is listed as order 11 and is required for 100% (Bottom of the Well dungeon, Lens of Truth)

quest_tracking.menu_location: Pause menu - tab between Key Items and Map
features: Tapestry view (press Y) for visual quest overview

notes.total_count_clarification: 13 total Threads of Time entries: 8 main story quests (some with sub-quests) + 5-7 side quests depending on how they're counted. 'Broken Windmill, Dry Well' is sometimes listed as side quest, sometimes as main story.
notes.optional_definition: To the Great Fairy, Happy Mask Shopkeeper, Stir the Scarecrow's Soul, and From a Pocket Egg Comes... are entirely optional for game completion but recommended for 100%
notes.flexible_order: Temple order in 'Awakening the Five Sages' is flexible; Forest Temple is typically first but not required
notes.quest_challenger_medal: Quest Challenger medal in Zelda Notes requires all events completed (all main + side quests)
